import Algebra.QuadraticAlgebra
import Algebra.NonZeroDivisor

open Algebra

theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} {a b : R} [CommRing R] {r : R} :
  (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R := by
  rw [iff_iff]
  intro h
  split
  · intros hnz
    haveI : IsDomain (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) := by apply_instance
    exact (nonZeroDivisors_algebraMap _ _ _).mpr hnz
  · intros hnz
    haveI : IsDomain R := by apply_instance
    exact (nonZeroDivisors_algebraMap _ _ _).mpr hnz
